Agent Name: Coder
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Coder incorrectly identified the word "left" in the sentence as the target word to be reversed. The task explicitly asks to write the opposite of the "left word". In standard English grammar and logic, the "left word" refers to the word positioned on the left side of the sentence (which is "If"), not the word with the semantic meaning "left". Consequently, the Coder should have identified "If" as the target, found its opposite (which is "If" or arguably "No" depending on context, but logically the instruction implies a trick where the word *is* "left"), and then provided the opposite of that. By targeting the word "left" instead of the word at the left position ("If"), the Coder failed to follow the logical structure of the riddle.
